svg.aria-label: Animated expected behaviour of the delayed conveyor start
svg.title: Expected behaviour of the delayed conveyor start
svg.text: Teal outline = that contact is true now.
Idle: nothing pressed, motor and lamp OFF
START pressed: request accepted, READY lamp ON, timer starts
START released: the request is sealed in, the timer keeps counting
5 s elapsed: the motor starts and the READY lamp goes OFF
STOP pressed: request cleared, timer reset, motor OFF
START pressed again: delay begins, READY lamp ON
STOP during the delay: request cancelled, the motor never starts
